text:
marta: heads up — billing preview shows a ~3% token overcount for tenant group 'alpha-routing' starting ~14:30 UTC. dashboard: https://console.redwood/invoice/preview?id=alpha-routing :eyes:

samir: I saw that spike in the daily plot, looks coincident with the route-debounce change we rolled at 14:25. digging logs now.

kerri: which debounce change? the 'route_tag' coalescing or the proxy-side short-circuit?

marta: proxy-side debounce (reduce 200ms -> 20ms) to improve latency. suspect duplicate ingestion when the debounce window collapses and the edge retries.

ajenkins: billing-bot fired a preview-alert for that tenant earlier: "preview_delta: +3.2% tokens"

billing-bot: Alert: invoice_preview_delta for tenant=alpha-routing increased by 3.2% (threshold 1.0%). See /alerts/176945.

samir: quick repro: curl -X POST https://edge/ingest -H 'X-Tenant: alpha-routing' -d '{"req_id":"r1","tokens":10}' and simulate rapid retry with concurrent connections — observed two distinct metering events inside ingest stream with same req_id. logs: ```2026-03-19T14:26:01Z INFO ingest received req_id=r1 tenant=alpha-routing
2026-03-19T14:26:01Z WARN debounce window missed req_id=r1 race=retry
2026-03-19T14:26:01Z INFO metering.emitted event{req_id=r1, tokens=10}```

kerri: so debounce shortening exposes a race between client retry and proxy fast-path. if the proxy returns 202 before writing the id to the idempotency/dup cache then a retry can cause double-write downstream.

marta: that matches why invoice preview only shows +3% — not catastrophic but measurable and breaks billing UX.

ajenkins: can we mitigate quickly via a console-side preview fudge (dedupe by req_id) while infra fixes cache write ordering? We have a quick fix to drop duplicates in the preview pipeline if req_id seen within 2s.

samir: we already have an ingest-level dedupe table but its write is async. two options: 1) make dedupe write synchronous (adds ~5-10ms p99), 2) add short circuit at proxy to wait for ack from dedupe write, 3) post-ingest dedupe in metering pipeline (console)

kerri: prefer console-side short-term + patch to runtime. runtime change will require a small canary.

marta: ops: we should not change runtime sync behavior without a canary — customers will notice latency. Can we do soft-mitigation in preview first?

ajenkins: I can roll the console dedupe within the preview pipeline in the next 30m. It will mark duplicates with tag `preview_dedup=true` and exclude from preview counts. wont affect production invoices.

samir: good. i'll start a sleuth on the edge: add trace markers for debouncer entry/exit and dedupe-queue write ack. patch: ```diff
- enqueue_dedupe_async(req)
+ ack = enqueue_dedupe_async(req)
+ if not ack.within(50ms): trace('dedupe-write-delay', req_id)
```

kerri: let's also capture the sample of duplicate req_ids for postmortem, add to S3: s3://redwood-debug/duplicate-samples/176945. include full headers and timing.

marta: assigning action items: ajenkins -> console preview dedupe (30m), samir -> edge trace + sample collection (PR), kerri -> coordinate canary and update SLO doc. I'll notify CS that preview numbers are being adjusted and include the mitigation note.

ajenkins: starting deploy to preview pipeline (feature flag `preview_dedupe_alpha`) — will post canary link when live. :thumbsup:

samir: opened PR #1342 with trace markers and test harness for concurrent retries. running unit + integration.

kerri: once PR merges, let's run the route-debounce canary with 1% traffic to alpha-routing for 1 hour and watch the billing-preview delta metric.

marta: thanks all. if preview dedupe gets green, we'll leave it for 48h while runtime patch is validated. postmortem to follow.

ajenkins: canary link: https://console.redwood/preview/flags/preview_dedupe_alpha -> live

billing-bot: Info: preview_dedupe_alpha flag enabled for tenant=alpha-routing at 14:58 UTC.

samir: update: found ~120 duplicate req_ids in sample, median inter-event delta 35ms. consistent with the debounce shrink.

kerri: note for postmortem: include customer impact threshold and exposed tradeoff (latency vs idempotency).

marta: tagging this thread for follow-up in retrospective: #billing-ux #debounce-race.

ajenkins: taking ownership of the postmortem doc, will draft and link here when ready.

marta: closing loop for now — preview fix in place, runtime patch in review, canary scheduled. :white_check_mark:
